This '''EG-6 power droid''' was present in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. It was in the palace of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] when [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] came to the palace as part of the [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescue]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. It squealed in pain as [[8D8/Legends|8D8]], under the command of its supervisor droid [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]], lowered a hot glowing iron on the soles of its feet.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This unnamed character was known as the "Dustbin Droid" during the production of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] and was called that in the [[Return of the Jedi Giant Collector's Compendium: Heroes, Villains, Creatures & Droids|''Return of the Jedi Giant Collector's Compendium'']]. A [[Topps]] trading card called it a "Dustbin Robot."<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=1983 Topps Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Series 1|cardname=Dungeons of Jabba the Hutt|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/72969/cid/5256868}}</ref> Although most sources claim the power droid was portrayed by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] actor [[Kiran Shah]], Callsheets instead list actress [[Carol Read]] as "Dustbin Droid", which Shah listed as "Droid (SFX)".<ref name="LarinLahrNot">[[:File:WhereIsLarinLahrNow.png|''Return of the Jedi'' Call Sheet Number 30]]</ref> In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', in the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] level, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] can be heard screaming.
